proof_summary: For \(n=49245934439103\), the integer \(K=550806419973833079563=a(n)+4\) lies strictly between the two proposed endpoints. A covering of all exponent classes modulo \(120\) by the divisors \(3,5,7,11,17,31,41,61,151,331,1321\) shows that every \(K2^e+1\) has a proper divisor, so \(K\) is itself a Sierpiński number.
